content.title: Timken 6206 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 30mm Bore x 62mm OD x 16mm Width
content.short_description: Timken 6206 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 30 mm bore, 62 mm outer diameter, and 16 mm width.
content.long_description:
The Timken 6206 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing in the open configuration, with no integral seals or shields on either side. It is dimensioned to 30 mm bore diameter, 62 mm outer diameter, and 16 mm width, matching the standard 6206-series envelope used across general industrial and power transmission equipment.

As an open bearing, the 6206 exposes the raceway and ball complement directly, allowing for relubrication and inspection without seal removal. This configuration is typically selected for applications where the housing or adjacent components already provide contamination protection, or where the operating environment is controlled.

Mounting and fit should be verified against shaft and housing tolerances per the 6206 dimensional standard before installation. No seal, shield, or other protective feature is included with this part.
